items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Caliope was right on her own as a boy... I lived between Caliope and... Drive between Howard Avenue and Caliope

ctx.x: And I hate to interrupt you, but I want to get that address business straight. Did you grow up there on Caliope? I grew up there.

Caliope was right on her own as a boy. Twenty-what age? Such ages as, I might say, well, I lived between Caliope and, oh, a boy twenty-seven, twenty-eight years of age. One hundred and a half years. Where did you move to from there? I moved up on Drive between Second and Third in the same neighborhood. I moved from Drive between Howard Avenue and Caliope to Drive between Second and Third in what we called the Garden District at that time. At that time, of course, the Garden District. All this was called the…
What do you call it now?
